## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the date a creative work became or will become available — an embargo lift or scheduled release date; carried as DL-clean [xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with [`gmeow:datePublished`](gmeow-datePublished.md) (formal issue) when an embargo separates availability from publication, and avoid [xsd:date.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date.)

### How to use

- Carry the availability instant on [`gmeow:dateAvailable`](gmeow-dateAvailable.md) as [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); pair with [`gmeow:hasDisclosurePolicy`](gmeow-hasDisclosurePolicy.md) when availability is conditional on a release decision.

### Examples

- ex:dataset [`gmeow:dateAvailable`](gmeow-dateAvailable.md) "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
